extraction.tool: Original native scan / closed-form edge alpha and foreground decontamination
extraction.ownership_guide_prompt: Use case: faithful historical illustration or ornament extraction. Edit the ORIGINAL supplied source region. Keep the COMPLETE original crowned seated bell ringer, both original hands, both long green hammers with their proper heads, ALL the original blue hanging bells above/right of the figure, and the original supporting bench. This is one original interacting musician/instrument group. Preserve every source-visible bell suspension and hammer end; clear the true gaps between bells, hammers and body. Remove all red/brown/blue/gold letter G strokes and every part of the flat gold letter field; do not invent an instrument frame where the source attaches to the capital, extend suspension rods, add bells, or repaint hidden anatomy. Keep the entire selected original subject at its original proportions: every original fingertip, toe, petal fold, serration, thin stem, curl, feather, painted highlight and print hatching. Clear the unwanted page or flat painted background and every genuine opening between subject parts. Selected pale, gold, blue or white painted or engraved subject surfaces remain opaque. Remove neighboring unrelated subjects and printed page rules, lettering or captions. Preserve only source-visible parts, including original truncated ends; no invented hidden anatomy, new leaves, new tips, extended stalks, restored details or modern replacement artwork. Do not symmetrize, beautify, redraw, sharpen, stretch or compress the hand-drawn original. Fine natural antialiased contours without stepped polygon cuts or paper halos. Genuine transparent alpha outside and within the real openings, no rectangle or checkerboard paint.

retained_generated_ownership_guide.purpose: Retained AI alpha guide only; delivered opaque RGB belongs to the unchanged native source.

review.notes: Viewed full original pages, the actual native original ROIs and aligned current native source/white/dark proofs. Every original visible hand, face, robe fold, prop and pale/gold/blue/green painted surface retained. True openings and unrelated glyph/flat field cleared. Original native RGB and proportions retained; registered AI alpha is ownership evidence only, never replacement texture. Bell group preserves the actual source suspension, four blue bells, both hammers and bench. Reclining figure retains source-visible forehead up to the actual manuscript edge, source orb-like object and patterned rectangular object; missing top of head is not invented. Bust retains complete original orb/cross, halo and visible upper body only.
